svg.title: Architecture after the move to Cloudflare
svg.desc: One platform serves the site and the server boundary, and one DNS zone sits in front of both. Supabase is kept: the schema, the row level security and the server-authoritative order function already exist and work, and moving them to D1 would be a rewrite with nothing to show for it (AD3). Turnstile is already the captcha, so it comes home to the same account.
